headline: The new season of The Kardashians opens with an AI-made sketch in which fake versions of the family glitch until the real family steps in.
score_reason: Entertainment novelty from one outlet; no wider consequence.
importance_line: It shows famous people using obviously AI-made video as an on-screen joke, which affects mostly viewers of the show; this is one outlet's description of a single TV sketch.
summary: Vulture reports that the season eight premiere of the family's TV series The Kardashians opens with clearly AI-generated versions of the family in far-off places, which start to glitch (one gets a tail, another's face turns into a fingernail) before the real family steps in and jokes about whether they are AI themselves. In the sketch the real Kris Jenner insists the "real family — real family — cannot be replaced."
notes: Air date of the premiere not stated in the article.
